body.name: Bhushi Dam & Waterfall Catchment
body.name_mr: भुशी धरण व धबधबा पाणलोट क्षेत्र
body.name_hi: भुशी बांध और झरना जलग्रहण क्षेत्र
body.guidance: High upstream rainfall in Tiger Hill catchment elevates sudden water surge danger. Do not step onto overflow masonry or waterfall plunge areas.
body.guidance_mr: टायगर हिल पाणलोटात मुसळधार पावसामुळे धरणाच्या सांडव्यावर अचानक प्रवाह वाढण्याची शक्यता. पर्यटकांनी पाण्यात उतरू नये.
body.guidance_hi: ऊपरी जलग्रहण क्षेत्र में भारी बारिश से अचानक जलस्तर बढ़ने का खतरा। पानी में न उतरें।
body.restrictions: Section 144 / Police advisory active during torrential rains after 17:00.
body.upstream_info: Fed by 4.8 km² steep catchment from Tiger Valley. Water level telemetry is modelled from radar & rain gauge proxies.
body.photo_description: Masonry overflow weir, natural rocky rapids, and downstream gorge.

body.name: Kune Falls & Valley Escarpment
body.guidance: Three-tiered 200m waterfall over basalt cliff. Wet spray causes slippery edges and minor pebble roll off cut slopes.
body.guidance_mr: २०० मीटर उंच कडा असून निसरड्या कड्यांवरून चालणे टाळा. कडे कोसळण्याचा मध्यम धोका.
body.guidance_hi: खड़ी चट्टान और फिसलन भरे किनारे। घाटी के किनारे न जाएं।
body.restrictions: Viewing restricted to marked viewpoints on Old Highway.
body.upstream_info: Water-level telemetry unavailable. Risk estimated from IMD radar & regional precipitation.
body.photo_description: Three-tiered waterfall cascading down sheer basalt escarpment.

body.name: Tiger's Leap (Waghai) Escarpment
body.status_label: High Wind & Cliff Shear (कडा कोसळण्याचा धोका)
body.guidance: Severe 650m sheer cliff drop. Dense fog and strong monsoon updrafts reduce visibility. Stay strictly behind railing.
body.guidance_mr: ६५० मीटर खोल दरी. जोरदार वारे व दाट धुक्यामुळे कड्याच्या कठड्यापलीकडे जाऊ नये.
body.guidance_hi: गहरी खाई और तेज हवाएं। सुरक्षा रेलिंग के पीछे रहें।
body.restrictions: Strict ban on climbing over safety barricades.
body.upstream_info: High windshear zone, rapid surface runoff drains into Konkan plains.
body.photo_description: High cliff top overlooking deep sheer Konkan drop.

body.name: Lion's Point
body.guidance: Exposed ridge between Lonavala and Aamby Valley road. Minor surface erosion observed on unpaved shoulders.
body.guidance_mr: उघड्या डोंगररांगेवर जोरदार वारे. रस्त्याच्या बाजूला माती खचण्याची शक्यता.
body.guidance_hi: खुली पहाड़ी कगार पर तेज हवाएं। सावधानी बरतें।
body.restrictions: Parking only in designated asphalt bays.
body.upstream_info: Surface sheet wash during intense showers.
body.photo_description: Panoramic ridge viewpoint between two valleys.

body.name: Rajmachi Trek & Udhewadi Route
body.status_label: Very High Trail Washout Risk (मार्ग बंद / वाहून जाण्याचा धोका)
body.guidance: 15km kutcha jungle road severely waterlogged. Four mountain seasonal stream crossings are in spate. Do not attempt on two-wheelers or without local guides.
body.guidance_mr: जंगल मार्ग चिखलामुळे अत्यंत निसरडा. ओढ्यांना आलेला पूर वाहून नेऊ शकतो. ट्रेकिंग टाळावी.
body.guidance_hi: रास्ता अत्यधिक फिसलन भरा और नाले उफान पर हैं। ट्रेक न करें।
body.restrictions: Forest department advisory in effect during red alerts.
body.upstream_info: No cellular telemetry. Satellite precipitation indicates over 160mm in 24 hours.
body.photo_description: Dense Sahyadri forest road with torrential seasonal stream crossings.

body.name: Amrutanjan Bridge / Bhor Ghat Expressway
body.status_label: High Rockfall & Mudslide Alert (दगडी दरड कोसळण्याचा धोका)
body.guidance: Steep cut slopes stabilized with wire netting experiencing heavy saturation. Watch for loose boulders rolling onto Pune-bound corridor.
body.guidance_mr: द्रुतगती मार्गाच्या कडेला दरड व लहान दगड कोसळण्याची शक्यता. चालकांनी वेग मर्यादित ठेवावा.
body.guidance_hi: चट्टान गिरने का खतरा। वाहन धीमी गति से चलाएं।
body.restrictions: Heavy vehicles advised to maintain 40 km/h ghat speed.
body.upstream_info: Continuous road safety sensor active. Overburden saturation 86%.
body.photo_description: High engineered rock cut adjacent to 6-lane expressway.

body.name: Adoshi Tunnel Vicinity
body.guidance: Approach to tunnel portal. Drainage culverts flowing at 70% capacity. Surface aquaplaning risk during sudden downpours.
body.guidance_mr: बोगद्याच्या मुखाजवळ पाणी साचण्याचा धोका. वाहनांचे स्किडिंग टाळण्यासाठी सावधगिरी.
body.guidance_hi: सुरंग के पास फिसलन का खतरा। सतर्क रहें।
body.restrictions: Normal transit permitted. Traffic patrol deployed.
body.upstream_info: Separate collision/incident risk monitored independently from natural hazards.
body.photo_description: Tunnel entrance through basalt mountain spur.

body.name: Monkey Hill Railway Ghat Corridor
body.status_label: High Rail Boulder Watch (रेल्वे ट्रॅकवर दगड पडण्याची शक्यता)
body.guidance: Central Railway ghat section. Historical boulder drop spot. Catch-water drains monitored; bank patrols deployed with detonators.
body.guidance_mr: रेल्वे मार्गावर दरड कोसळण्याची भीती. रेल्वे गँगमन सतत पाहणी करत आहेत.
body.guidance_hi: रेलवे ट्रैक पर पत्थर गिरने की आशंका। निगरानी जारी।
body.restrictions: Speed restriction of 30 km/h for descending trains.
body.upstream_info: Geotechnical fence sensor indicates minor tension cracks on upper terrace.
body.photo_description: Steep rail cutting with overhead electrification and rockfall shelter.

body.name: Thakurwadi Railway Catchment
body.guidance: Ghat brake-testing station. Water overflow from mountain culverts into ballast. Operational caution.
body.guidance_mr: रेल्वे ट्रॅकशेजारील ओढ्यांमधून पाण्याचा मोठा निचरा. रेल्वे वाहतूक सावकाश.
body.guidance_hi: ट्रैक के किनारे पानी का बहाव। सावधानी बरतें।
body.restrictions: Cautious running advised by railway control.
body.upstream_info: Catchment runoff drains towards Karjat plains.
body.photo_description: Railway station on mountain terrace surrounded by cliffs.

body.name: Patan Village & Hillside Settlements
body.name_mr: पाटण गाव व डोंगर पायथा वस्त्या
body.status_label: High Settlement Slope Alert (गावठाण दरड इशारा)
body.guidance: Upper slope exhibits weathered soil mantle with high antecedent saturation. Residents near eastern escarpment advised to remain alert for ground fissures.
body.guidance_mr: डोंगरउतारावरील घरांना माती सरकण्याचा धोका. जमिनीला भेगा किंवा पाण्याचे नवे झरे दिसल्यास तात्काळ स्थलांतर करावे.
body.guidance_hi: गांव के ऊपर की पहाड़ी से मिट्टी खिसकने का खतरा। सतर्क रहें।
body.restrictions: Local Talathi and Village Disaster Committee on standby.
body.upstream_info: Terrain slope 29°, soil moisture 84%. Nearest shelter at Bhangarwadi.
body.photo_description: Rural hamlet situated beneath steep basalt tableland.

body.name: Valvan Dam & Indrayani Headwaters
body.guidance: Reservoir water storage at 78% capacity. Controlled spillway release not currently required. Downstream riverbed clear.
body.guidance_mr: धरण पाणीसाठा ७८% भरला असून सध्या विसर्गाची गरज नाही. परिस्थिती सामान्य.
body.guidance_hi: बांध की स्थिति सामान्य। निचले क्षेत्रों में बाढ़ का कोई खतरा नहीं।
body.restrictions: Public entry restricted to dam garden promenade.
body.upstream_info: Hydropower catchment for Khopoli generating station.
body.photo_description: Broad masonry gravity dam and serene reservoir.

body.name: Lonavala Civic Center (Ryewood)
body.guidance: Flat urban plateau with good drainage. Municipal stormwater drains operating normally. Safe zone for emergency staging.
body.guidance_mr: शहरात पाणी साचलेले नाही. नागरी जनजीवन व वाहतूक सुरळीत.
body.guidance_hi: शहरी क्षेत्र में स्थिति सामान्य। मुख्य राहत केंद्र यहीं स्थित है।
body.photo_description: Town center with municipal council, hospitals, and transit hubs.
